**I'm Giridhar, a systems and developer-tools engineer with an electrical-engineering background.** I build tools that fix problems I actually hit, and when the bug is in someone else's project, I reproduce it, fix it in the smallest correct way, and get the fix merged upstream.

**Open to software engineering roles** in developer tooling, Linux and systems, embedded software, and AI-agent infrastructure. Remote or India-based.

## How I work

- **Reproduce first.** I don't change code until I can trigger the failure on demand.
- **Smallest complete fix.** I avoid broad rewrites; maintainers merge focused diffs.
- **Regression tests where they matter.** I add focused tests when they protect the behavior.
- **Say what was and wasn't tested.** Every PR states how it was verified.
